scope: One existing candidate: primary corneal function and source lineage, article/exposure, current comparator/known-rights limits and a bounded marginal-dollar decision.

selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether RM4404 offers reproducible useful corneal function with an interpretable article/exposure and a bounded product contribution, rather than a sensory-surrogate or major sterile-product project
selection.basis: Next eligible public-source sprint after APR closure, following independent conditional development order APR1/RM2/BLU3 and testing fresh evidence that could reverse the selection

independent_review_input.read_scope: Ten-page review recovered in Round16; RM-specific objective, rank, scope and budget passages rechecked in this sprint

delta: RM is the selected public-source sprint, not an automatic new first development asset. APR1/RM2/BLU3 is retained as the independent review conditional order; no calculated return or new allocation.

A 2025 institutional abstract publicly reports direct delayed-CMI sensory contrasts but lacks denominators and uses different methods from the final report. No additional independent cohort or final clustered result is credited.

Figure 18 three-digit counts are nested readings from three mice per group; its mixed statistical notation remains unresolved. Stronger unilateral chemical-model contrasts and early-regimen off-dosing results remain separate from late CMI limits.

Early-versus-delayed comparison changes treatment phase and time since dosing together. A ceiling-limited blink endpoint cannot independently establish sensory quality, optics, barrier protection or absence of hypersensitivity.

Literal filtration wording, fresh batch preparation and carrier-specific primary evidence narrow product inference. Salt/solvent, chemical stability, release, exact ocular exposure and tolerance remain unqualified; neither blanket carrier rejection nor full CMC as an initial universal gate is justified.

Cenegermin extension permits additional treatment and defines responder-specific outcomes; its SAP prespecifies observed-case analysis. Numeric result tables were not recovered. Orunea is an initiated epithelial-healing study, not a completed sensory result.
Known-family rights and retained economics remain unresolved. Close the bounded source pass; reopen only for a named substantive artifact or fact that changes the next commitment.
